dedupe_keys.name: arrets de bus sur le territoire de lannion tregor communaute 2018

description: Arrêts de bus sur le territoire de Lannion Trégor Communauté - 2018 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lannion-Trégor Communauté. Spot data locating the bus stops of Lannion Trégor Community. Coverage: Lannion-Trégor Communauté. The portal shows the English title as "Bus stops in the territory of Lannion Trégor Community - 2018" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Lannion-Trégor Communauté. Its keywords include moyen-de-transport, arrets-de-bus, autobus. The listing shows 4 download or service links in URL, CSV. The listing shows 2026-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
